term: information acquisition (a modern alternative reading of reception)
definition: An actual change in a system produced by input from an object or signal. This is a possible modern reading of reception, distinct from a capacity to have the form of another thing and distinct from divine causal knowing. No such change is asserted by CanHaveForm.
note: A comparison sense only, retained to prevent substituting a modern input-event model for the aptitudinal source wording. No thesis that intellect is or is not information processing is proved.
